paragraphs: SmartStop Self Storage REIT, Inc., a Maryland corporation (the "Company"), is a self-managed and fully-integrated self storage real estate investment trust ("REIT"), formed on January 8, 2013 under the Maryland General Corporation Law. Our year-end is December 31. As used in this report, "we," "us," "our," and "Company" refer to SmartStop Self Storage REIT, Inc. and each of our subsidiaries. Our Common Stock began trading on the New York Stock Exchange (the "NYSE") under the ticker symbol "SMA" on April 2, 2025.

We focus on the acquisition, ownership, and operation of self storage properties located primarily within the top 100 metropolitan statistical areas, or MSAs, throughout the United States and Canada. Based on the Inside Self Storage Top-Operators List ranking for 2025, and after accounting for recent market transactions, we are the 10th largest owner and operator of self storage properties in the United States based on rentable square footage. As of December 31, 2025, our wholly-owned portfolio consisted of 177 operating self storage properties diversified across 19 states, the District of Columbia, and Canada comprising approximately 122,000 units and 13.9 million net rentable square feet. Additionally, we owned a 50% equity interest in 13 unconsolidated real estate ventures located in Canada, which consisted of 10 operating self storage properties and three properties which were being developed into self storage properties as of December 31, 2025.

Further, through our Managed Platform (as defined below), we serve as the sponsor of Strategic Storage Trust VI, Inc., a publicly-registered non-traded REIT ("SST VI"), Strategic Storage Growth Trust III, Inc., a private REIT ("SSGT III"), and Strategic Storage Trust X, a private net asset value REIT launched in January 2025, ("SST X" and together with SST VI and SSGT III, the "Managed REITs"). We manage the properties owned by the Managed REITs. Inclusive of the properties owned by the Managed REITs and the properties owned by Delaware statutory trusts ("DSTs") sponsored by one of the Managed REITs, in total, as of December 31, 2025, we managed 52 of such operating self storage properties, consisting of approximately 41,000 units and 4.5 million rentable square feet.

Effective October 1, 2025, we acquired Argus Professional Storage Management, LLC ("Argus"), a third-party manager of self storage properties (the "Third Party Platform Acquisition"). See Note 4 – Third Party Platform Acquisition of the Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements for additional information. As such, as of December 31, 2025, we managed an additional 221 of such properties, consisting of more than approximately 98,000 units and 15.9 million rentable square feet (the "Third Party Platform"). The Third Party Platform, the Managed REITs, and the other properties operated by us as mentioned above, are referred to as the "Managed Platform."

In total, as of December 31, 2025, we managed 273 operating self storage properties, which we did not own, consisting of approximately 140,000 units and 20.4 million rentable square feet through our Managed Platform.

Our primary business model is focused on owning and operating high quality self storage properties in high growth markets in the United States and Canada. We finance our portfolio through a diverse capital strategy which includes cash generated from operations, borrowings under our syndicated revolving line of credit, secured and unsecured debt financing, equity offerings and joint ventures. Our business model is designed to maximize cash flow available for distribution to our stockholders and to achieve sustainable long-term growth in cash flow in order to maximize long-term stockholder value at acceptable levels of risk. We execute our organic growth strategy by pursuing revenue-optimizing and expense-minimizing opportunities in the operations of our existing portfolio. We execute our external growth strategy by developing, redeveloping, acquiring and managing self storage facilities in the United States and Canada both internally and through our Managed Platform, and we look to acquire properties that are physically stabilized, recently developed, in various stages of lease up or at certificate of occupancy. We seek to acquire undermanaged facilities that are not operated by institutional operators, where we can implement our proprietary management and technology to maximize net operating income.

We acquired Argus pursuant to a contribution agreement (the "Contribution Agreement"). The principal assets acquired were property management contracts, covering the management of more than 221 properties and 400 employees (as of October 1, 2025) and an operating lease for their corporate headquarters in Tucson, Arizona and other intellectual and personal property.

Additionally, we plan to continue to expand our third-party management platform in both Canada and the United States, by scaling our Third Party Platform or through additional investments in or acquisitions of third-party management firms.

We have provided financing to the Managed REITs in the form of mezzanine loans, bridge loans, promissory notes, and preferred equity as applicable. We intend to continue in this practice going forward, if necessary. We may look to further expand our lending practice to self storage facilities outside of the Managed REITs, potentially to third party managed properties or joint venture properties. We may enter into joint ventures or other forms of co-investments in order to scale our overall property count and diversify our portfolio of properties. Joint ventures may also allow us to acquire an interest in a property without requiring that we fund the entire purchase price, but for which we would target being the property manager, both in the U.S. and Canada.

As an operating business, self storage requires a much greater focus on strategic planning and tactical operation plans. Our in-house call center allows us to centralize our sales efforts as we capture new business over the phone, email, web-based chat, and text mediums. As we have grown our portfolio of self storage facilities, we have been able to consolidate and streamline a number of aspects of our operations through economies of scale. We also utilize our digital marketing breadth and expertise which allows us to acquire customers efficiently by leveraging our portfolio size and technological proficiency. To the extent we acquired facilities in clusters within geographic regions, we see property management efficiencies resulting in reduction of personnel and other administrative costs.

In addition, we have the internal capability to originate, structure and manage additional self storage investment programs or Managed REITs, which would be sponsored by SmartStop REIT Advisors, LLC ("SRA"), our indirect subsidiary. We acquired such capability in 2019 from Strategic Asset Management I, LLC (f/k/a SmartStop Asset Management, LLC), our former sponsor ("SAM"). We generate asset management fees, property management fees, acquisition fees and other fees and also receive substantially all of the tenant protection program revenue earned by our Managed REITs, as applicable. For the property management and advisory services that we provide, we are reimbursed for certain expenses that otherwise helps to offset our net operating expense burden. We primarily generate property management fees and receive a portion of the tenant protection program revenue from our third party owners and are reimbursed for certain costs incurred by our Third Party Platform, as applicable.

We focus on investing in self storage facilities and related self storage real estate investments that are expected to support sustainable stockholder distributions over the long term. Our primary investment objectives are to: (1) invest in real property in a manner that allows us to qualify as a REIT for U.S. federal income tax purposes; (2) provide regular cash distributions to our stockholders; (3) preserve and protect our stockholders' invested capital; (4) achieve appreciation in the value of our properties over the long term; and (5) grow net cash flow from operations in order to provide sustainable cash distributions to our stockholders over the long-term.

Our management team has experience acquiring self storage facilities across a broad spectrum of opportunities including physically stabilized facilities, recently developed facilities in physical or economic lease up, facilities that have just received a certificate of occupancy ("C/O"), facilities in need of renovation and/or re-development and ground up development. We have adopted an investment allocation policy, pursuant to which we will have first priority for investment opportunities, and if we decline any such opportunity, we will allocate it to another program sponsored by us after considering various factors. In considering and evaluating potential acquisition opportunities, and to augment our seasoned acquisition team, we employ our proprietary underwriting methodology. We believe that we maintain a competitive advantage in acquiring facilities given the scale of our business and the experience and industry relationships of our team. We maintain a network of self storage operators, real estate brokers and other market participants in the U.S. and Canada, which gives us unique insight into new and highly desirable acquisition opportunities.

We may enter into joint ventures, general partnerships, co-tenancies and other participations with real estate developers, owners and others for the purpose of owning and leasing real properties. Among other reasons, we may want to acquire properties through a joint venture with third parties or affiliates in order to diversify our portfolio of properties in terms of geographic region or property type or to co-invest with one of our property management partners. Joint ventures may also allow us to acquire an interest in a property without requiring that we fund the entire purchase price. In addition, certain properties may be available to us only through joint ventures. For example, we acquired a joint venture arrangement with SmartCentres Real Estate Investment Trust, an unaffiliated third party ("SmartCentres"), pursuant to which we and SmartCentres work together to identify primarily self storage development opportunities in certain regions in Canada.

headings: Summary of Principal Risk Factors
Risks Related to an Investment in SmartStop Self Storage REIT, Inc.
We have historically incurred net losses, have an accumulated deficit, and it is possible that our operations may not be profitable, or maintain profitability, in the future.
An active trading market for our common stock may not be maintained.
The market price and trading volume of shares of our common stock may be volatile.
Broad market fluctuations could negatively impact the market price of shares of our common stock.
Increases in market interest rates may result in a decrease in the value of shares of our common stock.
Our distributions to stockholders may change, which could adversely affect the market price of shares of our common stock.
If we lose or are unable to retain our executive officers, our business could be harmed.
Impairment of goodwill or other intangible assets may adversely affect our financial condition and results of operations.
If we fail to maintain an effective system of internal control over financial reporting and disclosure controls, we may not be able to accurately and timely report our financial results.
Our trademarks are important, and the loss of or our inability to enforce trademark and other proprietary intellectual property rights could harm our business.
Privacy concerns could result in regulatory changes that may harm our business.
Revenue and earnings from the Managed Platform are uncertain.
the conflicts that may arise or that it will address such conflicts in a manner that is more favorable to us than to the Managed REITs and Other Programs.
We may be unable to raise additional capital needed to grow our business.
A downgrade in our credit ratings could materially adversely affect our business and financial condition and the market value of our outstanding notes.
Prior to our recent listing on the NYSE, we had no operating history as a publicly traded company and may not be able to successfully operate as a publicly traded company.
If securities or industry analysts do not publish research or publish unfavorable research about our business, our stock price and trading volume could decline.
Risks Related to Our Corporate Structure
The limit on the number of shares a person may own may discourage a takeover that could otherwise result in a premium price to our stockholders.

Stockholders are bound by the majority vote on matters on which our stockholders are entitled to vote and, therefore, a stockholder vote on a particular matter may be superseded by the vote of other stockholders.
We have opted out of provisions of the Maryland General Corporate Law ("MGCL") relating to deterring or defending hostile takeovers.

Our rights and the rights of our stockholders to recover claims against our officers and directors are limited, which could reduce our stockholders' and our recovery against them if they cause us to incur losses.
Risks Related to the Self Storage Industry

We face significant competition in the self storage industry, which may increase the cost of acquisitions or developments or impede our ability to retain customers or re-let space when existing customers vacate.
We may not be successful in identifying and consummating suitable acquisitions, or integrating and operating acquired properties, which may adversely impact our growth and results of operations.
paragraphs: Below are risks and uncertainties that could adversely affect our operations that we believe are material to stockholders. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we do not consider material based on the information currently available to us may also harm our business. Unless the context otherwise requires, references to stockholders are generally intended to be references to our common stockholders.
Below is a summary of the principal risk factors we face. Please read it carefully and refer to the more detailed descriptions of the risk factors below this summary.

• If we pay distributions from sources other than our cash flows from operations, we may not be able to sustain our distribution rate, we may have fewer funds available for investment in real estate and other assets and our stockholders' overall returns may be reduced.
• An active trading market for our common stock may not be maintained.
• The market price and trading volume of shares of our common stock may be volatile.
• Our distributions to stockholders may change, which could adversely affect the market price of shares of our common stock.

paragraphs: SmartStop Self Storage REIT, Inc., 一間馬裏蘭州公司 (the "Company"), 為一間自營且完全整合的自用儲物不動產投資信託 ("REIT"), 於2013年1月8日根據馬裏蘭州公司法成立。我們的會計年度為12月31日。在本報告中，"we," "us," "our," 和 "Company" 皆指 SmartStop Self Storage REIT, Inc. 及其所有子公司。我們的普通股於2025年4月2日開始在紐約證券交易所 (the "NYSE") 以股票代碼 "SMA" 進行交易。

我們專注於取得、擁有及營運位於美國與加拿大主要100個都會區 (MSAs) 的自用儲物不動產。根據2025年Inside Self Storage Top-Operators List排名，並考慮近期市場交易後，我們為美國自用儲物不動產的第10大擁有及營運者，以可出租平方英呎計算。截至2025年12月31日，我們全資擁有之投資組合包含177間營運中的自用儲物不動產，分散於19個州、華盛頓特區及加拿大，約有122,000個單位及13.9百萬可出租平方英呎。此外，我們在加拿大擁有13間未合併之不動產合作夥伴關係的50%權益，這些合作夥伴關係包含10間營運中的自用儲物不動產及3間正在開發為自用儲物不動產的不動產，截至2025年12月31日。

進一步地，透過我們的 Managed Platform (如下所定義)，我們為 Strategic Storage Trust VI, Inc., 一間公開註冊的非交易REIT ("SST VI"), Strategic Storage Growth Trust III, Inc., 一間私人REIT ("SSGT III"), 以及 Strategic Storage Trust X, 一間於2025年1月啟動的私人淨資產價值REIT ("SST X"), 這些與 SST VI 和 SSGT III 合稱為 "Managed REITs"。我們管理 Managed REITs 所擁有之不動產。包括 Managed REITs 所擁有之不動產及由 Managed REITs 資助之德拉瓦州統計信託 ("DSTs") 所擁有之不動產，截至2025年12月31日，我們總共管理了52間營運中的自用儲物不動產，約有41,000個單位及4.5百萬可出租平方英呎。

自2025年10月1日起，我們取得 Argus Professional Storage Management, LLC ("Argus"), 一間第三方自用儲物不動產管理公司 ("Third Party Platform Acquisition"). 請參閱財務報表附註第4項 - 第三方平台取得，以取得更多資訊。因此，截至2025年12月31日，我們又管理了221間這樣的不動產，約有超過98,000個單位及15.9百萬可出租平方英呎 ("Third Party Platform"). 第三方平台、Managed REITs 及我們上述所提及的其他不動產，合稱為 "Managed Platform."
總計，截至2025年12月31日，我們透過 Managed Platform 管理了273間我們未擁有之營運中的自用儲物不動產，約有140,000個單位及20.4百萬可出租平方英呎。

我們的主業務模式專注於擁有並營運美國與加拿大高成長市場的高品質自用儲物不動產。我們透過多元化的資金策略來資助投資組合，包括來自營運活動的現金、我們 syndicated revolving line of credit 下的貸款、有擔保及無擔保債務融資、股票發行及合資企業。我們的業務模式設計為最大化可供分配給股東的現金流，並實現可持續的長期現金流成長，以在可接受的風險水平下最大化長期股東價值。我們透過追求在現有投資組合營運中的收入最佳化及費用最小化機會來執行我們的內生成長策略。我們透過開發、重新開發、取得及管理美國與加拿大自用儲物設施，並透過我們的 Managed Platform 來執行我們的外生成長策略，我們尋求取得已具備物理基礎設施、近期開發、處於租賃階段或取得使用執照的不動產。我們尋求取得未被有效管理的設施，這些設施未由機構經營者管理，我們可透過我們的專利管理及科技來最大化淨營運收入。
我們根據一項貢獻協議 (the "Contribution Agreement") 取得 Argus。取得的主要資產為物業管理契約，涵蓋超過221間不動產及400名員工 (截至2025年10月1日)，以及其位於亞利桑那州圖森市的總部辦公室的經營租賃，以及其他智慧財產權及個人財產。
此外，我們計畫持續擴展我們在加拿大與美國的第三方管理平台，透過擴展我們的 Third Party Platform 或透過對第三方管理公司的額外投資或取得。

我們已為 Managed REITs 提供融資，形式包括 mezzanine loans、bridge loans、promissory notes 及 preferred equity，視情況而定。我們有意持續進行此作法，如有需要。我們可能進一步擴展我們的貸款業務至 self storage facilities，不論是否為 Managed REITs，可能包括第三方管理的不動產或合資企業的不動產。我們可能成立合資企業或其他形式的共同投資，以擴大我們的不動產數量並分散我們的不動產組合。合資企業也可能讓我們取得不動產的權益，而無需我們資助全部購買新價，但我們目標為該不動產的管理人，於美國與加拿大皆然。

作為營運企業，self storage 需要更強調戰略規劃與執行作業計畫。我們的內部客服中心讓我們能集中銷售努力，透過電話、電子郵件、網路聊天及簡訊等媒介來獲取新業務。隨著我們的 self storage 不動產組合擴張，我們已能透過規模經濟來整合與簡化許多作業層面。我們也運用我們的數位行銷廣度與專業知識，透過我們的不動產規模與科技能力來高效取得客戶。我們若在地理區域內取得集羣式的不動產，我們會看到不動產管理的效率，進而減少人力及其他行政成本。

此外，我們擁有內部能力來發起、結構化與管理額外的 self storage 投資計畫或 Managed REITs，這些計畫將由 SmartStop REIT Advisors, LLC（"SRA"），我們的間接子公司所發起。我們於 2019 年從 Strategic Asset Management I, LLC（f/k/a SmartStop Asset Management, LLC），我們的前發起人（"SAM"）取得此能力。我們產生資產管理費用、不動產管理費用、收購費用及其他費用，並獲得我們 Managed REITs 產生的 substantially all 的租客保護計畫收入，視情況而定。對於我們提供的不動產管理與顧問服務，我們會獲得某些費用補償，以減輕我們的淨營運費用負擔。我們主要產生不動產管理費用，並從第三方所有者獲得部分租客保護計畫收入，並獲得我們 Third Party Platform 所產生的某些費用補償，視情況而定。
我們專注於投資 self storage 不動產及相關的 self storage 房地產投資，這些投資預期能長期支持股東的分紅。我們的主要投資目標為：(1) 以符合美國聯邦所得稅法規為 REIT 的方式投資實體不動產；(2) 向股東提供定期現金分紅；(3) 保護並維護股東的投資資本；(4) 長期提高我們不動產的價值；(5) 增加營運的淨現金流，以長期提供可持續的現金分紅給股東。

我們的管理團隊有經驗於不同機會中取得 self storage 不動產，包括已穩定運作的不動產、近期開發的不動產（處於物理或經濟租賃期）、剛取得使用執照（"C/O"）的不動產、需要翻修與/或重新開發的不動產，以及從零開始的開發。我們已採用投資分配政策，根據此政策，我們會優先考慮投資機會，若我們拒絕任何機會，則會將其分配給我們其他計畫，並考量多種因素。在評估與考量潛在收購機會時，為增強我們經驗豐富的收購團隊，我們運用我們專屬的評估方法。我們相信，由於我們業務的規模與團隊的經驗與產業關係，我們在取得不動產方面擁有競爭優勢。我們維持與美國與加拿大 self storage 管理者、不動產經紀人及其他市場參與者的網路，這讓我們對新且高度吸引人的收購機會有獨特的洞察。

我們可能與房地產開發商、所有者及其他人士成立合資企業、普通合夥企業、共有人關係或其他參與形式，以擁有與出租實體不動產。我們可能想透過與第三方或關聯公司的合資企業取得不動產，以分散我們不動產組合的地理區域或不動產類型，或與我們的不動產管理夥伴共同投資。合資企業也可能讓我們取得不動產的權益，而無需我們資助全部購買新價。此外，某些不動產可能僅能透過合資企業取得。例如，我們與 SmartCentres Real Estate Investment Trust，一個無關聯的第三方（"SmartCentres"）成立了一個合資企業安排，根據此安排，我們與 SmartCentres 合作，主要在加拿大的某些地區尋找 self storage 開發機會。

paragraphs: 下列討論與分析應與本 Form 10-K 所包含之合併財務資料，以及我們的合併財務報表及其附註一併閱讀。請參閱「關於前瞻性陳述之警示說明」部分，位於第一部分之前。
本公司為自營且完全整合之自用儲存不動產投資信託（"REIT"）。我們的會計年度為 12 月 31 日。在本報告中，"我們"、"我們"、"我們"及"公司"均指 SmartStop Self Storage REIT, Inc. 及其所有子公司。我們的普通股於 2025 年 4 月 2 日在紐約證券交易所（"NYSE"）以股票代碼 "SMA" 開始交易。

我們專注於美國與加拿大主要 100 個都會區（"MSA"）內自用儲存不動產之取得、擁有與營運。根據 2025 年 Inside Self Storage Top-Operators List 排名，並考量近期市場交易後，我們為美國自用儲存不動產之擁有與營運者中第 10 大者，以可出租平方英呎計算。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們的 wholly-owned 管理 portfolio 總計有 177 間營運中的自用儲存不動產，分散於 19 個州、華盛頓特區及加拿大，總計約 122,000 單位及 13.9 百萬可出租平方英呎。此外，我們在加拿大擁有 13 間未合併之不動產投資合作案的 50% 股權，這些合作案總計有 10 間營運中的自用儲存不動產及 3 間正在開發為自用儲存不動產的不動產，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日。

進一步地，透過我們的 Managed Platform（如下所定義），我們為 Strategic Storage Trust VI, Inc.（"SST VI"），一間公開註冊的非交易 REIT，Strategic Storage Growth Trust III, Inc.（"SSGT III"），一間私人 REIT，以及 Strategic Storage Trust X，一間於 2025 年 1 月啟動的私人淨資產價值 REIT（"SST X"）擔任發起人（"Managed REITs"）。我們管理 Managed REITs 所擁有之不動產。包含 Managed REITs 所擁有之不動產及由 Managed REITs 發起之特拉華州統計信託（"DSTs"）所擁有之不動產，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們總計管理 52 間營運中的自用儲存不動產，總計約 41,000 單位及 4.5 百萬可出租平方英呎。

自 2025 年 10 月 1 日起，我們取得 Argus Professional Storage Management, LLC（"Argus"），一間第三方自用儲存不動產管理公司（"Third Party Platform Acquisition"）。請參閱財務報表附註第 4 項「Third Party Platform Acquisition」以取得更多資訊。因此，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們又額外管理 221 間不動產，總計約 98,000 單位及 15.9 百萬可出租平方英呎（"Third Party Platform"）。Third Party Platform、Managed REITs 及我們上述所提及之其他不動產，均稱為 "Managed Platform"。
總計，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們透過 Managed Platform 管理 273 間我們未擁有之營運中的自用儲存不動產，總計約 140,000 單位及 20.4 百萬可出租平方英呎。

我們的主業務模式聚焦於美國與加拿大高成長市場中擁有與營運高品質自用儲存不動產。我們透過多元資本策略來資金融通我們的 portfolio，包括來自營運活動之現金、我們 syndicated revolving line of credit 之借款、擔保與無擔保債務融資、股權發行及合作投資。我們的業務模式設計為最大化可供分配給股東之現金流，並實現可持續的長期現金流成長，以在可接受風險水平下最大化長期股東價值。我們透過追求現金流最佳化與費用最小化機會來執行我們的內生成長策略，以提升現有 portfolio 之營運。我們透過開發、重新開發、取得及管理美國與加拿大之自用儲存設施，並透過我們的 Managed Platform 來執行我們的外生成長策略，我們尋求取得已具備物理基礎設施、近期開發、處於不同租賃階段或取得使用執照之不動產。我們尋求取得未由機構經營者管理之設施，以便我們能實施我們的專屬管理與科技，以最大化淨營運收入。
我們根據一項貢獻協議（"Contribution Agreement"）取得 Argus。取得的主要資產為管理合約，涵蓋超過 221 間不動產及 400 名員工（截至 2025 年 10 月 1 日），以及其位於亞利桑那州圖森市之總部辦公室之營運租賃，及其他智慧財產權與個人財產。
此外，我們計畫持續擴展我們的第三方管理平台於加拿大與美國，透過擴充我們的第三方平台或透過對第三方管理公司的額外投資或收購來實現。

我們已為 Managed REITs 提供融資，形式包括次級貸款、過橋貸款、本票與優先股，視情況而定。我們預計將持續進行此類做法，如有需要。我們可能進一步擴展我們的貸款業務至 Managed REITs 以外的自用儲存設施，可能包括第三方管理的不動產或合資企業的不動產。我們可能成立合資企業或其他形式的共同投資，以擴大我們的總不動產數量並分散我們的不動產組合。合資企業也可能使我們能在不需自行負擔全部購入價格的情況下取得不動產權益，但我們目標為成為該不動產的管理公司，於美國與加拿大皆然。

作為營運企業，自用儲存需要更強調戰略規劃與執行作業計畫。我們的內部客服中心使我們能集中銷售努力，透過電話、電子郵件、網路聊天與簡訊等多種方式獲取新業務。隨著我們的自用儲存設施組合擴張，我們已能透過規模經濟整合與簡化許多作業層面。我們也運用我們的數位行銷廣度與專業知識，使我們能有效取得客戶，透過我們的組合規模與科技能力來實現。我們若在地理區域內取得設施羣聚，我們會看到不動產管理效率，導致人力與其他行政成本的減少。

此外，我們擁有內部能力來發起、結構化與管理額外的自用儲存投資計畫或 Managed REITs，這些計畫將由 SmartStop REIT Advisors, LLC（"SRA"），我們的間接子公司所贊助。我們於 2019 年從 Strategic Asset Management I, LLC（f/k/a SmartStop Asset Management, LLC），我們的前贊助人（"SAM"）取得此能力。我們產生資產管理費用、不動產管理費用、收購費用及其他費用，並獲得我們 Managed REITs 所產生的租客保護計畫收入的 substantially all，視情況而定。對於我們提供的不動產管理與諮詢服務，我們會獲得某些費用補償，以抵消我們的淨營運費用負擔。我們主要產生不動產管理費用，並從第三方所有者獲得部分租客保護計畫收入，並為我們的第三方平台所產生的某些費用獲得補償，視情況而定。

我們已建立會計政策，符合一般會計原則（"GAAP"）。依照 GAAP 編製財務報表，需要管理階層在會計政策的應用上使用判斷力，包括做出估計與假設。以下為設定會計政策時所使用的估計與假設的討論，我們認為這些在財務報表呈現上是關鍵的。許多涉及 GAAP 應用的估計與假設可能對我們的財務狀況或營運績效，或與其他期間報告的資料可比性產生重大影響，這是因為這些項目需要高度不確定性的判斷力與主觀性，或這些項目容易受到變動的影響。這些估計與假設會影響我們報告的資產與負債金額、我們在財務報表日期對或有資產與負債的揭露，以及我們在本報告期間內報告的收入與費用金額。如果管理階層對各種交易的相關事實與情況的判斷或解釋不同，則可能應用不同的會計政策或記錄不同的資產、負債、收入與費用金額，導致財務報表的呈現有重大不同，或財務報表中報告的金額有重大不同。
我們認為我們的關鍵會計政策包括以下內容：不動產取得評估；評估我們的長期資產是否已減損；商譽與相關減損考量的評估；我們的商標與相關減損考量的評估；以及評估我們在合資企業中的權益是否應合併。以下對這些政策的討論補充，但不取代財務報表附註中「附註 2 – 重要會計政策摘要」所包含的會計政策描述，並意圖呈現我們在達成與應用每一項政策時所涉及的不確定性分析。

可能產生衝突，或以對本公司更有利的方式解決這些衝突。
本公司可能無法籌措足夠額外資金以支應業務成長所需。
本公司信用評等遭降級，可能對本公司業務及財務狀況造成重大不利影響，並降低本公司在外流通的債券之市場價值。
在本公司最近於紐約證券交易所掛牌之前，本公司並無作為上市公司之營運歷史，且可能無法成功運作為上市公司。
若證券或產業分析師未發表研究報告或發表對本公司業務不利之研究報告，本公司股票價格與交易量可能下跌。
與本公司公司結構相關之風險
個人所能擁有股票數量之上限，可能抑制可能以較高價格對本公司股票持有人而言之收購案發生。
股東須受制於對本公司股東有權投票事項之多數決，因此，針對特定事項之股東投票，可能被其他股東之投票所取代。
本公司已放棄馬裏蘭州一般公司法（"MGCL"）中有關防禦或抵禦敵意收購之相關條款。
本公司及股東對董事及高階管理人員之索償權利受到限制，這可能會降低本公司股東及本公司在該等人員導致本公司發生損失時之索償能力。
與自用儲物產業相關的風險
我們在自用儲物產業面臨顯著的競爭，這可能會提高收購或開發的成本，或阻礙我們保留客戶或在現有客戶離場時重新出租空間的能力。
我們可能無法成功識別並完成適當的收購，或整合及運營取得的不動產，這可能會對我們的成長及營運結果產生不利影響。
paragraphs: 以下為可能對我們營運產生不利影響的風險與不確定性，我們認為這些風險與不確定性對股東而言屬重大事項。除目前我們所知或根據現有資訊認為不具重大性之風險與不確定性外，尚有其他風險與不確定性可能對我們的業務造成損害。除非文意另有明確說明，否則提及股東時，通常指本公司普通股股東。
以下為我們所面臨的主要風險因素摘要。請詳閱並參考本摘要下方對風險因素的更詳細說明。
• 若我們從除營運現金流以外之來源發放紅利，我們可能無法維持現有紅利率，我們用以投資不動產及其他資產的資金可能減少，而股東整體之報酬可能因此降低。
• 本公司普通股可能無法維持活躍交易市場。
• 本公司普通股之市場價格及交易量可能波動。
• 我們對股東之紅利發放可能有所變動，此情形可能對本公司普通股之市場價格產生不利影響。
